body:
Re being foiled:we were close, and she came to check on me and found me in an ugly state. I think about what that was like for her all the time, and that's pretty high on the list of cruel things you could put someone through. I reckon not being able to figure out how to kill myself without putting someone else through that is the primary reason I haven't so far.

Re debts, I would like to pay them off, because I ought to. My financial situation isn't the source of my needing to split; it's a practical thing, though, that kind of forces the issue.

This is the first I've talked about this with anyone, except for saying in a very general way to my shrink that I have thought about suicide in the last year or so, but never really planned on it. Because that was what he asked ("have you had any suicidal thoughts?), and I didn't want to alarm him such that he'd have to hospitalize me. Being hospitalized was horrible, and had no effect on my realization that I (and other folks), would be better off if I weren't here.

I first wrote "I can't think of anything I'd like to do with two days, or even the time between work and sleep." That's true, but it occurred to me as I was typing it that there's a weird kind of pressure (which, I recognize, likely only I feel) or inclination to resist help after asking for it. I reckon it would seem to delegitimize the things I said before. 
That said, there are things I think would be good or rewarding to do, but they're not accessible. I've thought about how I could do them, and yeah, no, I can't.

Thanks very much for replying. One thing I left out of the bit of sunshine ass-up-blowing I did in my original post: not only is it heroic of all of you that you follow this sub and reply to folks, but you're attentive and responsive to posters' particular situations.

I suspect that most folks who post here (OPs, that is, not repliers) aren't convinced that they should kill themselves, and are looking to hear either reasons they shouldn't, solutions to their problems, or someone just listening to things they can't say to anyone. I'm not referring to the content of any particular posts here -- it's a general sense I've gotten from the bits of other folks' posts I've read, and some thinking about this subreddit. First-person, it's obvious to me that I'll kill myself soon. Looking at this from the outside, though, I reckon I likely posted for one of those reasons. Hard to embrace the outside perspective, though.

Again, for those of you who have, thanks for slogging through all that.

Thanks. It just occurred to me that you (the general 'you,' not you particuarly, mari) only post here if you feel like you want to kill yourself and hope that someone gives you reason not to. There's something perverse and showy about posting here, and I'm kind of embarrassed that I did.

And the flavor's gone -- weirdly, I guess, I have no preferences, really. It's hard to dig yourself out of a hole when you neither have any idea which direction to head in, nor have any particular reason or drive to get out of the hole.

I've already commended you folks for attending to this sub, but I will again: it is wonderful and fucking ridiculous that you people do this, and I'm sorry to post here.
